title: Sluggish checkout with slow downstream warnings
query: Orders keeps logging slow downstream call to payments. No errors, checkout just feels sluggish.
root_cause: Payments responds slowly, and the delay propagates to orders and the gateway.

remediation.detail: Restart payments and investigate why charges are slow.

evidence: Orders logs WARNING slow downstream call with downstream payments
Payments request duration is about three seconds
query_paraphrase: Orders keeps noting that its call to payments was slow. Nothing is erroring, but checkout feels laggy.
